{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hand of Solitude''' was the title given to the leader of the [[Rebel Knights of Solitude|Solitude]] militant group which was active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
